card.name: Multiple sclerosis relapse and activity wording
card.fires_on: Words just before an expected term like relapse, flare or disease activity in multiple sclerosis text, such as 'distinct', 'as', 'MS' or 'of'. It also fires partway through MS drug names such as fingolimod and ocrelizumab.

modes.label: Before relapse wording
modes.description: Linking or modifying words right before relapse, remission or exacerbation in MS course descriptions.
modes.example: with no<< distinct>> relapses or remissions.

modes.label: Inside MS drug names
modes.description: Partway through names of MS drugs like fingolimod and ocrelizumab.

modes.label: MS before relapse
modes.description: The word MS or disease right before relapse or rebound.
modes.example: Consider when severe<< MS>> relapse occurs during treatment
